## Requirements (contract § In scope)

1. **Budget** — $300/mo (the operator's ceiling, U-008; infrastructure only,
   A-2a) with 50/90/100 % e-mail alerts, by a committed dry-run-by-default
   script; the billing-admin steps fall to the operator (OP-12) only if the
   agent identity lacks the role.
2. **Test threshold** — a temporary budget with a threshold low enough to fire;
   its alert recorded; the budget deleted.
3. **BigQuery billing export** — dataset created by script; the export link
   enabled (console step for the operator, OP-12, if no API path exists);
   a read-only verification query.
4. **Spend ledger** — `docs/build/reports/spend/<YYYY-MM>.md`: measured GCP
   lines from the export; non-GCP lines (Cloudflare/R2, registrar, domains —
   FEA-08) operator-reported or "unknown — owed"; agent usage per wave (A-2b);
   every figure labelled measured / operator-reported / estimate; the 40 GB
   autoresize cap (B-11) recorded as an assumption.
5. **Pointers** — the README/ops cost claims ("≈ $0/mo", "~$9/mo") replaced by
   a pointer to the spend ledger (the full ops-doc rewrite is P35.4).

## Plan

The contract authorises three production mutations (S5-3 11A list, LEDGER
GATE DECISIONS 2026-10-01T04:28:49Z; expires GATE-G4): the $300/mo budget,
one temporary test-threshold budget (deleted after it fires), and a BigQuery
billing-export dataset. Live window: **any time (billing metadata)** — the
03:00–10:00Z never-band does not apply (the contract's own window text).

1. `ops/gcp/cost-guard.sh` — the sole scripted write path, same contract as
   `protect.sh`/`alerts.sh`: dry-run default (`--check`), `--apply`, `--verify
   [--from-state]`, per-leg actions (`prestate|budget|testbudget|
   testbudget-delete|dataset|exportcheck|all`), evidence dirs under
   `docs/build/logs/cost-guard/` (gitignored), sha256s recorded, per-mutation
   rollback printed. The billing account id is discovered live from the
   project's billing link (`gcloud billing projects describe`) and never
   committed; `SIG_BILLING_ACCOUNT` overrides. The budget is scoped
   `--filter-projects=projects/$SIG_GCP_PROJECT` — the $300 ceiling is SIG
   infrastructure only and the billing account serves other projects.
2. Enabling step (prerequisite of the named mutation): `gcloud services
   enable billingbudgets.googleapis.com` on the project — spend-neutral,
   reversible (`services disable`), needed before any budgets read/write.
3. Live legs (window = any time): prestate → enable API → budget →
   testbudget → dataset → verify. The export *link* enablement is an
   operator console step (no public API path; OP-12) → deferral.
4. `docs/build/reports/spend/` — `SPEND_LEDGER.md` (rules + label
   vocabulary + monthly procedure), `spend_ledger.csv` (rows),
   `agent_usage.csv` (per-wave usage, never currency), `2026-10.md` (the
   first month: pending/estimate rows only — nothing fabricated).
5. Pointer edits: `README.md` deployed paragraph,
   `docs/build/reports/GCP_DEPLOYMENT.md` "$9/mo" claim labelled estimate +
   ledger pointer, `ops/README.md` hosted-spend pointer, `INFRA_RUNBOOK.md` §8.
6. `tests/ops/test_cost_guard_iac.py` (33 tests); `cost-guard.sh` registered
   in `tests/ops/test_gcp_iac.py`'s script lists.
7. ADR-193 (project scope, test-threshold lifecycle, ledger conventions).
8. DEFERRALS rows (D-P34.5-1/-2/-3) + coverage row SIG-OPS-009 →
   MET-ENGINEERED(D-P34.5-1;D-P34.5-2;D-P34.5-3); `:e0` anchors +
   `SIG-OPS-009:r11-2` assessment appended at closeout.

## Test matrix

| test | asserts | dies if |
|---|---|---|
| `test_script_check_mode` | `cost-guard.sh --check` prints the plan offline, exit 0, no ADC | dry-run surface breaks |
| `test_mutation_allowlist` | stubbed gcloud/bq: only the authorised mutations ever execute (API enable, two budget creates, name-checked test-budget delete, dataset mk) | the script grows unlisted writes |
| `test_ceiling_budget_shape` | create args: amount 300, thresholds 0.5/0.9/1.0, `--filter-projects`, IAM recipients kept, channel wired when resolvable | the ceiling contract regresses |
| `test_test_budget_shape` | test budget ≤ $0.01, 100 % threshold, test displayName | the fire-mechanism regresses |
| `test_delete_name_checked` | `testbudget-delete` refuses a budget whose displayName is not the test one | a wrong budget could be deleted |
| `test_verify_*` | `--verify` and `--verify --from-state` emit OK/DRIFT/MISSING and exit 1 on non-OK | the outcome diff goes blind |
| `test_no_email_or_project_literal` | no `@` address / project id literal in the script | a leak enters |
| spend-ledger tests | every money figure in `spend/*.md` carries a basis label; label vocabulary closed; ceiling + autoresize assumption present | the label discipline regresses |
| pointer test | README/ops cost claims carry a label + a `spend/` pointer | an unlabelled projection returns |
